This connection is supported by the observed interaction between Chlorpromazine and Drd5, which is part of a broader pathway involving dopamine receptor signaling. The integration of these pathways suggests that Chlorpromazine could exert its effects on Drd4 through a mechanism involving dopamine receptor activation, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
